mapper.select: SELECT FROM ops_page WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND page_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
SELECT FROM ops_page WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND page_id=#{id} AND status='PUBLISHED'

SELECT FROM ops_page p WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND page_id > #{after} AND version=(SELECT MAX(v.version) FROM ops_page v WHERE v.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND v.page_id=p.page_id) ORDER BY page_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM ops_page WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND page_id=#{id} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT FROM ops_page WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND page_id=#{id} ORDER BY version LIMIT 51 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ops_page SET status='PAUSED',lock_version=lock_version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND page_id=#{id} AND status='PUBLISHED'
UPDATE ops_page SET status=#{status},lock_version=lock_version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND page_id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND lock_version=#{expected}
